images.label: 星沙城 · Stardust
images.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished cinematic fantasy location title overlay for video, using the attached image as the authoritative style and layout reference. Replace its Chinese title with exactly “星沙城” and its English subtitle with exactly “Stardust” (capital S, remaining lowercase). Do not include parentheses. Large three Chinese characters in a single horizontal row, elegant sharp Song/Ming serif strokes with pearly silver-white beveled 3D metal surfaces, restrained warm champagne highlights, subtle dark contour/shadow for legibility over video. Smaller widely tracked classical serif English centered below. Closely match the reference's elegant eight-point warm golden star at left and graceful thin comet/orbital swoosh curving around the left and sweeping under the title to a taper on the right; delicate prismatic highlights, restrained glow. Keep lettering crisp, correct and uncluttered. Match the reference's refined visual identity, not a city illustration. One isolated title only, generous transparent margins and wide landscape canvas about 3:1. True transparent background (alpha), no black rectangle, no scenery, no extra text, no watermark. All star points and swoosh tips fully within canvas.
